issues.title: Fix README.md quickstart accuracy bugs
issues.dod: Fix five issues in the 5-Minute Quickstart section: (1) Step 2: replace `arm sources add docs/armature-prd.md` with `arm sources add --url docs/armature-prd.md --type filesystem` — the positional path form is not accepted by the binary; (2) Add `arm worker-init --check || arm worker-init` as a new step immediately after `arm init` in Step 1, with a one-line note that this registers worker identity in local git config once per clone; (3) Add `arm install-skills` as a step immediately after worker-init, with a note that this deploys bundled agent skills to .claude/skills/, .gemini/skills/, and .codex/skills/; (4) Step 3: replace `arm decompose-context --sources src-001` with `arm decompose-context --sources all` — sources are assigned UUIDs not user-chosen IDs; (5) Remove Step 5 entirely — it duplicates the `arm transition` call already shown in Step 4 with inconsistent syntax. The result is a 4-step quickstart with no duplicate commands.

issues.title: Add Missing Reference Documentation for Agents
notes: These are gaps — information agents need that exists in source code but nowhere in operator-facing docs. Without them, agents must read source code to self-diagnose errors from arm validate and arm doctor.

issues.title: Write docs/validation-codes.md with all error, warning, and doctor codes
issues.dod: Write docs/validation-codes.md documenting all output codes from `arm validate` and `arm doctor`. Format each entry as: code, one-line trigger description, and fix. Document errors (prefix E): E2 unresolved parent link (parent ID not found in state), E3 unresolved blocked_by link target, E4 dependency cycle detected in DAG, E5 invalid type hierarchy (valid: epic can parent story/task/bug; story can parent task/bug; task and bug cannot parent anything), E6 task missing required field — scope, acceptance, or definition_of_done required for non-terminal tasks, E7 uncited node (no source-link or accept-citation), E8 unknown source UUID in citation (UUID not in manifest — re-run sources sync), E9 definition_of_done exceeds 500 characters, E10 invalid glob pattern in scope field, E12 citation referencing unknown source. Document warnings (prefix W): W1 scope overlap between sibling tasks (resolve with arm link to set dependency), W2 acceptance criteria has no test_passes or manual_review typed entry, W3 estimated token budget exceeded (title + DoD + context exceeds 4000 tokens), W4 broad scope (**, **/* or . covers entire tree), W5 task scope spans 3+ directories without context_files set, W6 complexity mismatch (small task with >5 scope files, or large task with <2), W7 vague DoD (contains: properly/correctly/good/well/appropriate/suitable), W8 conflicting decisions (same topic, multiple choices on one issue), W10 phantom scope (literal path in scope not found on disk; glob patterns and (new) suffix entries exempt), W11 vague outcome (too short or contains: done/completed/finished/ok/fixed). Document doctor codes (prefix D): D1 git/armature divergence (commits reference issue IDs not in done/merged/cancelled state), D2 stale claims (claimed issue TTL expired), D3 orphaned ops (ops log references issue IDs absent from index), D4 broken parent refs, D5 dependency cycles in DAG, D6 uncited issues. Also: add --quiet flag to docs/commands.md validate section (suppresses INFO lines, still prints COVERAGE and OK); add --verbose flag to docs/commands.md doctor section (emits file paths for D3 violations and names uncited issue IDs for D6). Add cross-reference link from both commands.md sections to docs/validation-codes.md.

issues.title: Document ARM_LOG_SLOT environment variable in docs/commands.md
issues.dod: Add an 'Environment Variables' section at the end of docs/commands.md. Document ARM_LOG_SLOT: type (string), behavior (when set, appends ~<slot> to the worker UUID to form the log file name — e.g. worker `abc123` with ARM_LOG_SLOT=2 writes to `.armature/ops/abc123~2.log`; without it, writes to `.armature/ops/abc123.log`), purpose (parallel agent dispatch: multiple processes sharing the same worker UUID must use distinct slots to preserve the single-writer-per-log invariant), how to use (set `export ARM_LOG_SLOT=<n>` before any `arm` command in each agent process; use sequential integers 1, 2, 3... for each concurrent agent). Include a two-agent example showing distinct slot assignments.

issues.title: Write docs/concepts.md agent reference for core system model
issues.dod: Write docs/concepts.md as a reference for agents that need to understand the Armature system model to make correct decisions in edge cases. State each concept as operational rules, not narrative. Cover 8 concepts: (1) Ops log and materialization — each worker appends to its own JSONL file at .armature/ops/<worker-id>.log; state files under .armature/state/ are derived caches rebuilt by replay and are never source of truth; never edit ops files directly; (2) Worker identity — registered via `arm worker-init`, stored in git config key armature.worker-id, unique UUID per clone; re-running without --check generates a new UUID; use `arm worker-init --check || arm worker-init` idiom; (3) Claim lifecycle — claim via `arm claim`; default TTL 60 minutes; send `arm heartbeat <id>` (max 1/min) to keep alive; a claim is lost if TTL expires without heartbeat; in dual-branch mode downstream tasks require merged not done to unblock; (4) DAG hierarchy — valid parent-child types: epic can parent story, task, bug; story can parent task, bug; task and bug cannot parent anything; this is enforced by E5 validation; (5) Citations and validation — every issue must have a citation before `arm validate` passes; two paths: `arm source-link` (links to a registered source document) or `arm accept-citation` (self-certifies with rationale); `arm validate --ci` exits non-zero on any error; (6) Confidence levels — `decompose-apply` creates issues in draft state; draft issues are invisible to the ready queue; promote with `arm dag-transition --issue <root-id>` before workers can claim; (7) Single vs dual-branch — single-branch: .armature/ lives on main branch, tasks go directly done→complete; dual-branch: .armature/ on orphan _armature branch, .arm/ worktree for ops writes, downstream tasks require merged not done; (8) Source documents and decomposition — register sources via `arm sources add`; `arm decompose-context --sources all` packages source content for an AI agent to analyze; `arm decompose-apply --plan plan.json` loads the resulting task DAG. Add a Documentation section to README.md listing the docs/ files including a link to docs/concepts.md.
acceptance: docs/concepts.md exists
All 8 concepts present
Each concept contains at least one concrete command or rule agents can act on
README.md Documentation section links to docs/concepts.md
